caption_L1: This is a area graph named Zambia : Fertility rate from 2008 to 2018. A linear scale from 0 to 6 can be found along the y-axis, labeled Number of children born per woman. The x-axis plots Year on a linear scale with a minimum of 2008 and a maximum of 2016.
caption_L2L3: The average number of children born to woman reduced over the period from 2008 to 2018. At the start each woman had on average 5.5 children and ten years later this dropped to around 4.7 children per woman. There seemed to be a steady drop over each year.
